title: Find who earns above their department's average
prompt: For every employee who has a department and earns more than the average salary of that department, return first_name, salary and department_avg, the department's average salary rounded to a whole number. Sort by first_name. An employee who earns exactly the average does not qualify.
hints: Each employee has to be compared with a number that belongs to their group.
Put the department's average beside every employee in a WITH step, then filter in the main query.
avg(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department_id) AS department_avg, then WHERE salary > department_avg

wrongAnswers.misconception: Compares with the average of all employees instead of the department's.
Includes an employee who earns exactly the average.

feedback: Check a department with a single employee. That person earns exactly the average and must not appear.
